:::{#sol-normal-vector-practice}

Subtracting $7$ from both sides gives

$$
2 x_1 - x_2 + 4 x_3 - 7 = 0,
$$

which is $\dprod{\vec{w}}{\vx} + b = 0$ with $\vec{w} = \tp{(2, -1, 4)}$ and $b = -7$.
So $\vec{w} = \tp{(2, -1, 4)}$ is a [normal vector of $H$](#def-normal-vector).
Any nonzero multiple of it is one too,
since multiplying the equation by a nonzero number leaves $H$ unchanged.

:::
